_comment: Joint-action search experiment at equal full-turn time (docs/SEARCH_PORTFOLIO.md): C08 arms A (current), B (action portfolio), C (per-branch ply-2 predictions), D (both); v12 arms A and B (v12 already predicts per branch). Committed XXL policy, V off, heuristic evaluation, depth and coefficients fixed; A/A copies of both A arms; interleaved, paired fixtures. Fresh tuning seed 20261230 (20261220, chosen first, was consumed by T0016's 5XL screens; never reuse 20261009, 20261020, 20261031, 20261101, 20261102, 20261107 or 20261108, nor the reserved 20261201 (V data), 20261210 (P features) and 20261211 (V pilot)). PONLY_STATS adds the PLY2 and PORTFOLIO counters. A favourable result here is a tuning result: confirmation needs an unseen seed (T0006).
